🇲🇽🏭 <u>MEXICO FAST-TRACKS $3.5 BILLION IN PRIVATE INVESTMENT</u>

Mexico's top business chamber confirms the Sheinbaum government's single-window system under Plan Mexico is working: more than $3.5 billion in private projects — national and foreign — already authorized, with energy generation leading the way.

"The projects we've submitted get resolved quickly. Soon we'll have an announcement, because more than $3.5 billion in investments have already been authorized," said CCE president José Medina Mora, citing the May 4 decrees that cut red tape and stopped the SAT from stalling projects.

While Washington bets on tariffs, Mexico is clearing the runway for capital.

🇲🇽🎨 Los Tigres del Norte will join the "México Canta" semifinal in Los Angeles. — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, announcing the August 23 semifinal The binational contest's first-ever US semifinal lands at the Orpheum Theatre on Aug 23 — free entry with registration, broadcast on Canal 22. Los Tigres del Norte — 60M records sold, 6 Grammys, 12 Latin Grammys — will be honored and accompany the 7 Mexican-American semifinalists. The contest promotes new narratives in Mexican music, away from violence and drugs.

text: 🇲🇽✊ "You are not alone. Mexico is your home." "We will always receive you with dignity, with respect and with open arms." — Rosa Icela Rodríguez, Interior Secretary, on "México te abraza" The strategy runs 24/7 across 14 states with 34 federal agencies: 1.57M services, 453K hot meals, 79.7K medical consults, 180K Paisano welfare cards with 2,000 pesos, 98.6K IMSS affiliations — and a SEGOB command post with zero major incidents since January 2025.

🚨🇲🇽 271,193 Mexicans repatriated from the US — met with food, medical care and a welfare card. — Sergio Salomón Céspedes, INM Commissioner Jan 20, 2025 – Aug 13, 2026: 271,193 nationals received — 171,508 by land, 99,685 on 816 flights into 10 airports. 95% come from Chiapas, Guanajuato, Guerrero, Veracruz, Oaxaca, Michoacán, Puebla and Edomex. "The President's standing demand: they are not numbers or statistics — they get humane treatment."

🇲🇽🏭 "We're doing well — and every month will be better." "I told you the economy would take off more in the second half, because many public works delayed mostly for bureaucratic reasons are now starting. We're doing well and every month will be better." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, as the peso hit 16.98 per dollar The peso traded at 16.98 per dollar in wholesale operations on Friday — the superpeso near its strongest levels in years.

🇲🇽🌎 "Coordination without subordination is delivering results." "Beyond it being the DEA, the cabinet decided it's important that he go show the data — and that the strategy of coordination without subordination is delivering results." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, on García Harfuch's trip to a DEA event in Argentina Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch will present Mexico's security results at a DEA-organized event in Argentina, after initially not planning to attend.

🇲🇽🔍 20 homicides in one day — Mexico's lowest daily figure in 15 years. — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, morning press conference Thursday's nationwide homicide count was 20, the lowest daily figure in 15 years. High-impact crimes continue to fall under the current security strategy: attention to root causes, coordination with states and intelligence work.

🇲🇽✊ "In Mexico, the people of Mexico decide." "Mexico has a long history of defending its sovereignty — Independence, the interventions of the 19th century, US troops in Veracruz in 1914. In every case, a heroic defense, because in Mexico the people of Mexico decide. Mexico is free, independent and sovereign." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, responding on US visa revocations She noted PRI and PAN governments "opened the doors to US agencies," and said attempts to use Mexico for another country's electoral politics were always rejected.
